name: using-cmux
description: Skill for operating cmux terminal multiplexer (and c11-compatible clones). Pane splitting, sub-agent spawning/monitoring/result collection, command sending, screen reading, and notifications.

hooks.command: if [ -n "$CMUX_SURFACE_ID" ] && [ -z "$CMUX_NO_RENAME_TAB" ]; then CMUX="${CMUX_BUNDLED_CLI_PATH:-cmux}"; REF=$("$CMUX" identify | jq -r '.caller.surface_ref'); NUM=$(echo "$REF" | cut -d: -f2); CUR=$("$CMUX" tree --all --json | jq -r --arg r "$REF" '[.. | objects | select(.ref? == $r) | .title? // ""] | first // ""'); case "$CUR" in "[$NUM] "*) ;; *) "$CMUX" rename-tab --surface "$REF" "[$NUM] Claude Code" ;; esac; fi
